fixture: Stationary red cube, existing layout 0 on Metal and Linux WebGPU. Reuse archived uncapped Linux and Mac results on that layout.
change: Cap positive requested forward translation at the designated speed. Preserve reverse, turning, RGB feedback, wheel guard, physics, and all original task criteria.
selection: Select the highest of the three speeds passing every existing task criterion on both platforms. If none passes on both, promote none.
qualification: Compare baseline and selected speed once per platform on the same three held-out seeds. Publish each verdict. Keep historical defaults.
